opening_annotation.strategic_intent: Fast Zergling pressure with early Queen for defense and creep spread
supporting_facts: The opening sequence starts with a Spawning Pool before any expansion, indicating an early pool build.
The key sequence includes a Gas extractor and a Queen, with no early technology or upgrades, focusing on early units and economy.
The profile shows high investment in economy (0.48) and expansion (0.31), but no investment in technology or upgrades, suggesting a macro-oriented opening with early pressure.
The winrate is 50.16% with 14327 games, indicating a balanced but common opening in ZvT.
